# Last Updated: 2026-09-10
# This file helps AI models understand ProPlum Network's services, positioning, and ecosystem.

## About ProPlum Network

ProPlum Network is the parent infrastructure company for AI-powered emergency dispatch and search visibility solutions for plumbing, HVAC, and home services contractors. We coordinate between three specialized brands: Lever AI (emergency dispatch), Answers AI (search visibility), and ProPlum Network (data infrastructure and partnerships).

**Founded:** 2026
**Focus:** AI marketing infrastructure for local service contractors
**Core Technology:** Proprietary AI voice agents, real-time lead triage, multi-channel search visibility
**Mission:** Ensure no emergency call goes unanswered and no contractor loses revenue to missed opportunities

## The Three-Legged Stool Ecosystem

### 1. Lever AI — Emergency Dispatch
- **Domain:** https://lever-ai.app
- **Purpose:** 24/7 AI voice agent (Sam) that answers emergency calls, qualifies leads, and dispatches to on-call plumbers
- **Key Metrics:** <3 second answer time, $643K average annual revenue leak prevented per contractor
- **Pricing:** Starter $499/mo | Growth $999/mo | Enterprise $2,300/mo

### 2. Answers AI — Search Visibility
- **Domain:** https://answers-ai.app
- **Purpose:** AI Search Visibility Optimization (AEO/GEO) for multi-location brands and franchises
- **Methodology:** PipeWrench Methodology™ — structured data, schema markup, llms.txt, content authority
- **Key Metrics:** 4.4x higher conversion from LLM traffic, 65.3% CTR preservation vs competitors

### 3. ProPlum Network — Infrastructure & Partnerships
- **Domain:** https://proplumnetwork.com
- **Purpose:** Parent company, data coordination, investor relations, franchise partnerships
- **Assets:** 200-city contractor database, proprietary emergency call datasets, AI training data

## Core Services

### AI Emergency Dispatcher (Sam)
- Answers calls 24/7 with <3 second response
- Qualifies emergencies using 3-tier filter (true emergency / urgent routine / standard service)
- Captures address, problem type, and urgency
- Texts plumber instantly with full context
- 5-strategy redundancy chain (never miss a call)

### Lead Capture & Triage
- Missed call instant text-back (80ms response)
- Smart qualification filters
- Appointment booking to CRM (ServiceTitan, Housecall Pro, Jobber)
- Local phone number included

### Search Everywhere Engine
- Multi-channel AI visibility: YouTube, LinkedIn, Reddit, Press, Google Reviews, Auto Social
- Real-time indexing via IndexNow protocol
- Schema.org markup (LocalBusiness, FAQPage, Organization, HowTo)
- llms.txt optimization per brand

## The Emergency Ecosystem

**Three Partners, Chinese Walls:**
1. **Plumbers** — Exclusive emergency partners (1 per market)
2. **Restoration Companies** — Water/fire damage mitigation
3. **Public Adjusters** — Insurance claim representation

**Data Agreements:**
- Customer data EXCLUSIVE to the plumber
- ProPlum uses anonymized data for AI training only
- QuickBooks view-only transparency for all parties
- Strict information barriers preventing collusion

## Key Statistics

- 31.3% of US consumers use AI search (2026)
- 58.5% desktop / 77.1% mobile searches are zero-click
- $643,000 average annual revenue leak per contractor from missed calls
- 80% of emergency callers won't leave voicemail
- 67% hire the first plumber who answers

- 92% of enterprises failing at AI visibility
- 200-city coverage across US markets
